title: cache-hooks.sh — internals
subtitle: scripts/cache-hooks.sh — single entry point for all 5 Claude Code lifecycle events
plain_subtitle: Inside the one script that runs whenever Claude tells us something happened

steps.label: Read stdin JSON
steps.detail: $(cat) — Claude Code pipes the hook payload over stdin.
steps.plain_detail: Claude sends a little message about what just happened.

steps.label: extract() via jq
steps.plain_label: Pick out the bits we need
steps.detail: extract() helper pulls session_id, cwd, hook_event_name from the JSON via jq.
steps.plain_detail: We grab the chat ID, the folder, and the kind of event.

steps.label: sed fallback (no jq)
steps.plain_label: Backup plan if a tool is missing
steps.detail: Falls back to sed-based extraction when jq isn't on PATH (default Git Bash on Windows lacks jq).
steps.plain_detail: If the computer doesn't have jq installed, fall back to a more basic tool.

steps.label: Validate session_id (path-traversal guard)
steps.detail: case "$session_id" in *[!a-zA-Z0-9_-]*) session_id="" ;; esac — anything that could escape the cache-timers dir (e.g. "../../.ssh/...") gets blanked. The empty-sid check below then quietly skips per-session writes.
steps.plain_detail: If the chat ID has weird characters that could trick the script into deleting other files, blank it out so we won't write a per-session file.

steps.label: case "$event" in …
steps.detail: The case statement is the heart of the dispatcher.
steps.plain_detail: The script decides what to do based on what kind of thing happened.

steps.label: SessionStart → state=none
steps.detail: Fresh session, no request sent yet.
steps.plain_detail: A brand-new chat hasn't built up any cache.

steps.label: UserPromptSubmit | PreCompact → active
steps.detail: Both regular prompts and /compact flip to active so the indicator never lies during compaction.
steps.plain_detail: Whenever Claude is doing work, mark the chat as busy.

steps.label: Stop → state=idle:<epoch>
steps.detail: Records when the turn ended so the segment can compute remaining = TTL - (now - epoch).
steps.plain_detail: Claude finished — record the time so the countdown can start.

steps.label: SessionEnd → rm + exit
steps.detail: Drops the per-session JSON so the desktop tile promptly removes the row. Skips the rest of the script.
steps.plain_detail: When the chat ends, remove its file so the floating tile drops the row.

steps.label: * → exit 0
steps.detail: Defensive fall-through: if Claude Code adds a new event we don't know, we silently no-op.
steps.plain_detail: If we get something we don't understand, do nothing and move on.

steps.label: Write legacy file
steps.detail: printf '%s' "$legacy_val" > ~/.claude/.cache-timestamp — back-compat for old status lines.
steps.plain_detail: Also update an older shared file so older setups still work.

steps.label: [ -z "$session_id" ] && exit 0
steps.detail: Without a session_id we can't write the per-session file — the legacy mirror was enough. Also catches the path-traversal-blanked case from d-validate.
steps.plain_detail: If we don't know which chat this is (or it was blocked as unsafe), we just stop after updating the shared file.

steps.label: Preserve started_at
steps.detail: If the per-session file already exists, jq-lookup the prior started_at and reuse it (so 'when did this chat begin' stays stable across hook events).
steps.plain_detail: If we already know when the chat started, keep that time.

steps.label: Atomic .json.tmp → mv (json_escape every field)
steps.detail: Build the JSON via printf, write to .tmp, then mv — so the watcher never sees a half-written file. Every string field goes through json_escape() so a literal quote or backslash in cwd / project_name can't break the JSON.
steps.plain_detail: Save the file in a safe way, with every text field cleaned so quotes and backslashes can't break the format.

steps.label: SessionStart cwd-dedupe
steps.plain_label: Clean up duplicates for this folder
steps.detail: When a fresh session starts in a folder another session was already in, delete the stale files. Prevents zombie rows in the tile after a restart. The cwd is json_escaped before the grep so quotes inside cwd don't break the match.
steps.plain_detail: If you restarted the chat in the same folder, throw away the leftover row.

steps.label: find -mmin +1440 -delete
steps.plain_label: Throw out files older than a day
steps.detail: Best-effort GC: any per-session file untouched for >24 h gets removed on the next hook fire.
steps.plain_detail: Old chat files get cleaned up automatically after a day.
